I have my FISP coupon this season, so I will put NPK and urea on this main maize plot because the soil is tired after so many years of cropping. I also have manure from my animals that I will work into the soil before planting, and I will use the hybrid seed that comes with the subsidy. I cannot afford spraying chemicals on food crops, and we depend entirely on the November rains, so there will be no irrigation. My family will do most of the planting and weeding, but I will hire a few days of ganyu for the heavy land preparation since my back is not strong at this age.
